name: Penpot
summary: Open-source design tool in the browser. Closer to Figma than Canva, but great for thumbnails and social graphics once you set up your own templates.
gains: Reusable components = your own template system
tradeoffs: No giant template library or stock photo library like Canva
setupSteps: Create a board at your size (e.g. 1280×720 for YouTube thumbnails)
Build 2–3 layouts you reuse and save them as components
Grab free photos from Unsplash/Pexels and export to PNG
